svg.title: My ninja way — Sanchit Thakur
svg.desc: Megha stands back to back with Naruto beside three things she builds: living interfaces, motion with a story arc, and enterprise-grade data flows.

g.text: Believe it — then train & ship it
AI/ML Engineer & Quant Researcher by day, autonomous systems builder by night.
Probabilistic ML, PyTorch architectures & GenAI / RAG pipelines
Multi-factor decision engines, regime shift detection & backtesting
Full-stack Next.js systems & clean data pipelines in production
“I don't just train models. My code is my ninja way.”
NINDŌ · 38 REPOS · 62 STARS · DATA SCIENCE & AI SHINOBI
